english.title: Producer or authorised representative fail to provide free environmental information about new EEE

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[a producer,]_
(B)_[an authorised representative of a producer,]_

failed to provide information free of charge about preparation for reuse and environmentally sound treatment for a new type of EEE, namely **(..SPECIFY EEE..), that had been placed on the market for the first time by

(C)_[you]_
(D)_[that producer]_

within one year of that equipment being placed on the market
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 24(1), 90(2) and 91(2) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
